"\"Caller identification\" is an app provided by HeyTap and its third-party partners that identifies and flags unknown phone numbers.
This app needs to: connect to the internet to identify and flag unknown phone numbers online and update the local phone number database and other services; and read unknown incoming and outgoing call numbers, call time, and device information (including device ID and device model) to identify and flag unknown phone numbers online.
The number identification results provided by this app come from data provided by other users, information publicly available on the internet, and data provided by third-party partners.
(1) Completely accurate identification results are not guaranteed by HeyTap and its third-party partners, who are only filtering the data by technical means and are doing their best to provide users with reliable results. Users still need to verify for themselves the authenticity, accuracy, validity, and security of these phone and SMS numbers.
(2) HeyTap and its third-party partners have provided error reporting and number re-flagging features to help users report incorrect information.
(3) HeyTap and its third-party partners will not disclose your personal information to any other companies, organizations, or individuals without your consent unless otherwise permitted by laws and regulations.
You can turn this service on or off by going to \"Settings - Caller identification\" in the Phone app. After you turn off this service, unknown phone numbers will no longer be identified and flagged online, but you can use identification and flagging services based on the local number database. For details, refer to the %1$s, %2$s, and %3$s."
